2020: COVID-19 ends the third observing run prematurely

In early 2020 as the COVID pandemic unfolded, the third observation run “O3” of the @LIGO@scicomm.xyz detectors and Virgo was suspended at the end of March. Despite this premature end, O3 was a great success with almost 60 gravitational-wave candidates.

Operations at GEO600 could be continued (almost) as usual, mainly by remote control of the detector and the automatic alignment procedures implemented at GEO600 from the early days on.
